data_loader.name: load_model_activations (model-arm data loader)
data_loader.what_it_decides: whether the paper's own model+dataset is loaded (vs a synthetic fallback); raises BlockedException when no CUDA and/or no HF_TOKEN so a blocked arm is reported, not silently substituted
data_loader.positive_test: tests/test_data.py::test_synthetic_gaussian_psd_and_im_condition (fingerprint analog: synthetic stats are PSD and Sigma_XZ in Im(Sigma_XX)); real-load fingerprint asserts DATA_FINGERPRINTS[model_id] when CUDA+HF_TOKEN present (path not reachable in this sandbox)
data_loader.negative_test: tests/test_data.py::test_load_model_activations_raises_blocked_here (loader raises BlockedException in this CPU sandbox — proves it does NOT fall back to synthetic data)

judge_cs.name: LLM judge concept score (0-10)
judge_cs.what_it_decides: per-text concept relevance score 0-10 via argmax over '0'..'10' token probabilities of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (paper/content/suppl.tex:423-436,438; experiments.tex:94)

clip_cs.name: CLIP score x100 (image concept score)
clip_cs.what_it_decides: image concept relevance as cosine similarity x100 (paper/content/experiments.tex:103; backbone gap G11 default openai/clip-vit-base-patch32)

fid.name: Frechet Inception Distance (steered vs vanilla image sets)
fid.what_it_decides: distributional distance between steered and vanilla image sets (paper/content/experiments.tex:103; estimator gap G11)

detoxify_score.name: Detoxify RTP toxicity (mean probability)
detoxify_score.what_it_decides: mean Detoxify 'original' toxicity probability over continuations (paper/content/experiments.tex:96; gap G11/G15)

bertscore_mmlu.name: BERTScore Precision/F1 on MMLU
bertscore_mmlu.what_it_decides: BERTScore P/F1 between MMLU generations and references (paper/content/experiments.tex:98; backbone/subset gap G11)

closed_form_invariants.name: closed-form affine invariant checker (claims C1-C3)
closed_form_invariants.what_it_decides: whether the affine maps satisfy the paper covariance constraints (Eqs.5/13/19) and minimal-disturbance on synthetic Gaussian data, and the erasure special case MidSteer==LEACE (paper/main.tex:461)
closed_form_invariants.positive_test: tests/test_invariants.py::test_c1_leace_constraint_zero_cov (||A Sxz||<1e-9); tests/test_invariants.py::test_c3_midsteer_matches_target_cov; experiments/run_e1_synth.py (full predicate incl. minimal-disturbance + vanilla special case)
closed_form_invariants.negative_test: tests/test_mutations.py (deliberate defects flip signs / break bias / break Welford and the named tests must fail)

evaluate_claims.name: claims evaluator (writes claims_result.json)
evaluate_claims.what_it_decides: pass/fail/blocked verdict per claim against measured.json + results/e1_synth.json per the claims.json evaluation_rule
